{{Top|leg}}
The '''Endless Hour''' was the [[Human/Legends|Ussan]] term used on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] to describe the long afternoon light that accompanied the twilight in the city of [[Ussa]]. Beginning their workday in the early morning allowed them to return home to spend the endless hour with their families. The many parks and restaurants of Ussa were popular gathering places during the endless hour. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, many Ussans stayed within their homes to avoid giving the Imperial agents a reason to persecute them.
